services.name: Web Design & Development
services.title: Web Design & Development Company in Hubli–Dharwad | TANVO
services.metaDescription: TANVO builds fast, responsive and scalable websites for ambitious brands, using Next.js, React and headless CMS architecture. Based in Hubli–Dharwad, Karnataka.
services.lede: Fast, responsive and scalable websites engineered to convert and scale with your business.
services.intro: A website is the one asset that works for you continuously, and most fail quietly — slow on the connections your customers actually use, awkward on the devices they actually hold, and impossible to update without a developer. We build sites that avoid all three.
whatYouGet: Modern framework architecture built on Next.js and React, so the site stays maintainable as it grows
Fluid responsive typography that reads correctly from a 360px phone to a widescreen display
Headless CMS integration so your team edits content without touching code
Bespoke interactive details — the considered motion and micro-interactions that separate a memorable site from a template

related.name: Buy N Build
related.note: a high-performance architectural platform with interactive 3D spatial configurators and an automated lead pipeline

services.name: E-Commerce Flagships
services.title: Headless Shopify & E-Commerce Development | TANVO
services.metaDescription: Custom headless e-commerce storefronts on Shopify Plus — sub-second product filtering, custom checkout, ERP sync and multi-currency. Built by TANVO in Karnataka, India.
services.lede: Custom headless storefronts delivering tactile shopping experiences and friction-free checkout.
services.intro: Most storefronts lose customers in two places: a catalogue that takes too long to filter, and a checkout that asks too much. A headless build lets us fix both, because the shopping experience is no longer constrained by a theme.
whatYouGet: Headless Shopify Plus storefronts, where the front end is built for your catalogue rather than adapted from a template
Sub-second product filtering, so browsing a large catalogue does not feel like waiting
Custom cart and checkout workflows designed to remove friction at the point of purchase
ERP and inventory synchronisation, so stock and pricing stay correct without manual reconciliation
Global multi-currency support for selling across borders

related.name: The Slow House
related.note: a headless Shopify storefront pairing tactile Scandinavian editorial design with fluid catalogue filtering

services.name: UI/UX Design & Prototyping
services.title: UI/UX Design & Prototyping Studio | TANVO
services.metaDescription: User-centric product architecture, customer journey mapping, systematic design libraries and WCAG 2.1 accessible interfaces. UI/UX design by TANVO, Hubli–Dharwad.
services.lede: Product architecture and design systems that bring clarity to complex digital experiences.
services.intro: Complexity is not the enemy — unexplained complexity is. We map how people actually move through a product, then design the structure that makes the complicated parts feel obvious.
whatYouGet: User-centric product architecture: what belongs on which screen, and why
Deep customer journey mapping grounded in how your users actually behave, not how we assume they do
Systematic design libraries in Figma, so the twentieth screen is as consistent as the first
Interactive prototypes you can click through and test before a line of production code is written
WCAG 2.1 accessibility built into the design, not retrofitted after launch

services.name: Brand Identity & Systems
services.title: Brand Identity & Design Systems Agency | TANVO
services.metaDescription: Enduring visual identities, vector logo construction, editorial typography hierarchies and complete design token systems. Brand identity by TANVO, Karnataka, India.
services.lede: Visual identities and design systems that communicate authority and earn lasting trust.
services.intro: A logo is the smallest part of an identity. What determines whether a brand looks credible two years in is the system underneath it — the type scale, the spacing rules, the tokens that keep every touchpoint consistent when different people are building them.
whatYouGet: Vector logo construction on a proper grid, so the mark holds up at every size it will ever be used at
Editorial typography hierarchies — a real type scale, not a handful of arbitrary sizes
Complete design token systems that keep colour, spacing and type consistent across web, product and print
Brand guidelines your team and any future vendor can actually follow
Visual identity kits ready for handover

services.name: Custom Web Apps & SaaS
services.title: Custom Web Application & SaaS Development | TANVO
services.metaDescription: Bespoke web applications, internal operational dashboards and customer portals engineered by TANVO — a digital product studio in Hubli–Dharwad, Karnataka.
services.lede: Bespoke web applications, operational dashboards and customer portals.
services.intro: When off-the-shelf software stops fitting how you actually work, the usual response is to change how you work. Building the tool instead is often cheaper than the accumulated cost of the workaround.
whatYouGet: Bespoke web applications shaped around your operations rather than a vendor's assumptions
Internal operational dashboards that surface the numbers your team checks daily
Customer portals that move routine requests out of your inbox
The same engineering standards as our public-facing work: accessible, responsive and maintainable
